(69) Reading 54 is stated in full: a statement that an alliance exists, that a named room is with the room, or that a collaboration is under way places the alliance's making only before the statement (G45 reading 12), so it cannot be ordered after an earlier upkeep that it does not name; an announcement that an alliance is new (announced, secured, now formed, finally got, accepted) dates it at its own hour. Applied backwards, it finds three lines already written whose first coalition shown is such a statement after an earlier upkeep: AyyMD-049 (c0107, an invitation into the chat of an alliance that already exists), buffalobills-033 (c0089, an ally already made) and dwarffortress-064 (c0129, a collaboration already under way). Each is re-ruled by an appended line from S-O-H to EL-J before the census; the earlier lines stay. The other order lines rest on an act, a proposal, an acceptance or an announcement at its hour, or on an alliance that the line shows arising after the upkeep (metalgearsolid-031, earthbound-062, thesimpsons-031), so they stand. (70) A call to fight, then an announcement of the room's new alliance three minutes later, shows the order by the hours (PinkUnion-034 c0042, h+22.53, then c0043, h+22.58: REJ). Statements that alliances exist after an upkeep cannot be placed (Rainbow6-032 c0386; OneTrueEmilia-060 c0019 under the defence posts c0012 and c0018: limit), and one post that names the alliance and the joint defence is one act (OrderOfTheKoi-059 c0001, c0002: limit).
